name: Hot and sour soup
ingredients_raw: Corn Starch, Dehydrated Vegetables 18% (carrot, cabbage, garlic), Salt, Sugar, Dehydrated Mushrooms (8%), Dried Glucose Syrup, Disodium 5' Guanylate, Disodium 5'- Inosinate (Flavour Enhancers, E627, E631), Soy Sauce Powder (soybean, wheat, salt), Onion Powder, Caramel (Natural Colour, E150d), Chilli Powder (1%), Acetic Acid (Acidity Regulator, E260), Xanthan Gum (Thickener, E415), Silicon Dioxide (Anticaking Agent, E551), Sunflower Oil, Pepper Powder.
